children: Robinhood tokens are now live on Injective, making Robinhood's tokenized assets accessible within the Injective ecosystem.

The integration gives INJ a direct usage channel tied to a retail brokerage's tokenization stack. It also adds a TradFi-integration narrative to Injective, with the practical change being that users in the ecosystem can access Robinhood's tokenized assets through the network.

The announcement establishes availability, but does not specify which tokenized assets are included or how usage will develop. That access connects the announced product to Injective's existing ecosystem.

title: Injective: Robinhood Tokens Are Live - 30 Aug 2026
